title: Hyperdimensional Geometry
description: Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

puzzle.goal: In n dimensions a ball of radius r is a nest of thin spherical shells. The surface area of the unit sphere in n dimensions follows from evaluating the n-dimensional Gaussian integral in Cartesian and in spherical coordinates. Write the volume of the n-ball as an integral over shells of radius ρ.
puzzle.name: Hypervolume of an n-ball (shell integral)
puzzle.ask: The integral is π^(n/2) r^n / Γ(n/2 + 1). Find the 4-volume of a 4-ball of radius r = 2 (Γ(3) = 2).
puzzle.method: (∫e^(−x²)dx)^n = π^(n/2) in Cartesian coordinates, and S_(n−1)∫ρ^(n−1)e^(−ρ²)dρ = S_(n−1)Γ(n/2)/2 in spherical ones; equate to get the sphere area, then integrate shells.
